data.title: Dense Temperate Forest Flora
data.summary: Free low poly trees, bushes, ferns, grasses, fungi, deadwood and forest floor tiles for a thick temperate woodland, with a dense starter scene.
data.description: The vegetation library for a thick temperate mixed woodland. Eleven broadleaf species and five conifers in three forms each (young, mature, and old or wind shaped), plus the shrub layer, the field layer, fungi, deadwood, rock and the two metre floor, path and stream tiles that go under all of it, so a wood can be filled without repeating a silhouette. Species are real and named correctly: oak, beech, silver birch, sycamore maple, ash, rowan, hazel, alder, willow, hornbeam, wild cherry, Scots pine, Norway spruce, silver fir, European larch and yew. The look is faceted low poly with flat colours and one light procedural bark map, held to the standard fidelity budget so a scene can carry hundreds of placements. Everything is a static mesh: there is no rig and no animation anywhere in the pack, because a rigid node transform cannot bend a stem or a frond and faking it costs more than it gives.

starterScene.description: A dense stretch of old temperate woodland with a trodden path winding in from the front and a stream crossing it at a ford of stepping stones. Oak, beech, sycamore, ash and hornbeam close the canopy overhead, spruce, silver fir and Scots pine mix in from the west with larches on the far edge, and a lighter birch and rowan glade opens to the east over bluebells, anemones and a fairy ring. Alder and willow lean over the water among reeds and lily pads. Under it all: holly, hawthorn, hazel coppice, bramble and rhododendron, bracken, ferns, nettles and foxgloves along the path, and a floor of moss carpet, leaf litter and pine needle tiles carrying fallen trunks, stumps, boulders, fly agarics and ceps.

assets.title: Old Wood Heart (Dense Temperate Forest Flora)
assets.summary: A dense stretch of old temperate woodland with a trodden path winding in from the front and a stream crossing it at a ford of stepping stones. Oak, beech, sycamore, ash and hornbeam close the canopy overhead, spruce, silver fir and Scots pine mix in from the west with larches...
assets.description: A dense stretch of old temperate woodland with a trodden path winding in from the front and a stream crossing it at a ford of stepping stones. Oak, beech, sycamore, ash and hornbeam close the canopy overhead, spruce, silver fir and Scots pine mix in from the west with larches on the far edge, and a lighter birch and rowan glade opens to the east over bluebells, anemones and a fairy ring. Alder and willow lean over the water among reeds and lily pads. Under it all: holly, hawthorn, hazel coppice, bramble and rhododendron, bracken, ferns, nettles and foxgloves along the path, and a floor of moss carpet, leaf litter and pine needle tiles carrying fallen trunks, stumps, boulders, fly agarics and ceps.
